blocks.text:
After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight to El Calafate. Airfare is paid separately. On arrival, transfer to your hotel.

The day's programme includes the El Calafate Balcón Experience by Mil Outdoor: a 4×4 drive to a viewpoint at 1,050 m above sea level overlooking Lago Argentino. In clear weather, you can see Fitz Roy and Cerro Torre. The route continues to the Laberinto de las Piedras stone labyrinth. The excursion takes around 3 hours and is included in the tour price. Departure time is arranged to fit your arrival flight. Overnight at the hotel.

blocks.text:
Day 4 · After breakfast, group tour to the Perito Moreno Glacier, in Los Glaciares National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The first stop is a viewpoint that reveals the size of the glacier against Lago Argentino, its white streak of ice stretching as far as the eye can see towards the Andes.

Then reach the public walkways, a series of paths and staircases offering panoramic views of the glacier from around 400 metres away. Hear the thunderous crackle of the ice and, if you are lucky, watch a great chunk break away and crash into the water below.

Option: an ice-trekking adventure on the glacier, ending with a cocktail served with glacier ice (USD 600 per person).
